label: Chain length as a path length
section: Chain length as a path length
subgoals: Start the path at the scan-in port
Add the Manhattan length of each hop in order
Minimize over orders as a traveling-salesman path

label: Nearest-neighbour construction
subgoals: Hop from the port to the nearest unvisited flop
Repeat until every flop is visited
Watch for stranded far flops and a long final hop

label: 2-opt improvement
subgoals: Reverse a contiguous segment of the order
Compare the hops into and out of the segment before and after
Repeat improving moves until none remains
